info.title: Tranquil Sand Table API
info.description: REST API for controlling the Tranquil kinetic sand table device. For real-time updates, connect to the WebSocket API at `/ws` (see asyncapi.yaml).

get.description: Returns the current playback state including pattern, playlist, progress, and settings.

patch.description: Partially update player settings. All fields are optional. Setting pattern_uuid or playlist_uuid starts new playback.

post.description: Start playing a pattern or playlist. Provide either pattern_uuid (single pattern) or playlist_uuid (with optional shuffle/loop).
Stop current playback. Use emergency_stop=true for immediate halt without deceleration.
Skip to the next pattern in the current playlist. Only works in playlist mode.

200.description: Skipped to next pattern, returns player state

get.description: Get a paginated list of all downloaded patterns.

post.description: Upload a new pattern file (.thr format). The pattern will be converted to binary format and a thumbnail generated. Progress is broadcast via WebSocket.

get.description: Get metadata for a specific pattern.

delete.description: Delete a pattern and its associated files.

get.description: Download the binary pattern file. Only available for unencrypted patterns.
Get the PNG thumbnail preview of a pattern.
Get a paginated list of all playlists.
Get details for a specific playlist.

post.description: Add or remove patterns from a playlist.

patch.summary: Update playlist metadata and/or replace pattern list

post.description: Set the order of patterns in a playlist.

get.description: Get the JWT store token from the device's DRM license. Used for authenticating with the pattern store.
Returns basic device information including model, type, and firmware version.
Returns current system configuration including timezone, NTP server, and hostname settings.

post.description: Update system configuration settings. All fields are optional.

get.description: Returns the list of available timezones with their POSIX rules.
Returns the list of available LED effects.
Returns the LED system configuration including version and channel information.
Returns the current state of a specific LED channel.

post.description: Update the state of a specific LED channel. All fields are optional.
Blocks until homing completes. Player state broadcasts on the WebSocket reflect progress.

500.description: Motion controller unavailable or homing failed

post.description: Clears NVS, patterns, playlists and license, then restarts ~300ms after responding.

put.description: Replaces the entire schedule. Change is broadcast to WebSocket clients and synced to the cloud.

feed_rate.description: Playback speed, 1 (slowest) to 5 (fastest). Constant surface speed in table-radii per minute. Persisted across reboots.
Set playback speed, 1 (slowest) to 5 (fastest); values outside the range are clamped. Persisted across reboots.

PlayRequest.description: Provide either pattern_uuid OR playlist_uuid. If both provided, starts playlist from the specified pattern.

download_url.description: URL to download pattern (empty if encrypted)

num_leds.description: Number of LEDs in this channel

DeviceConfigPatch.description: Partial update. Absent or zero-valued fields are left unchanged.

days_of_week.description: Bitmask, bit 0 = Sunday .. bit 6 = Saturday (0x7F = all days)

UpdatePlaylistRequest.description: Partial update. pattern_uuids, when present, replaces the entire ordered list.
